notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant and Piggie book. Gerald the elephant wants to take a nap but is repeatedly interrupted, mostly by Piggie. Key themes are tiredness, anger/grumpiness, and the concept of rest. The hat serves as a plot device (Gerald uses it to signal he is napping). Piggie should be added to character_images_needed as she is the main secondary character who interrupts the nap. Both characters need Mo Willems licensed or TPT-sourced clip art as Boardmaker generics will not match student recognition from the book cover.
